{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
target_group = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check for any rows where converted == 1 but status is 'refunded'
mismatch = target_group[(target_group['converted'] == 1) & (target_group['status'] == 'refunded')]

# Count such rows
mismatch_count = len(mismatch)

# Print result
mismatch_count"}
